d: Two of Oregon's logging giants, J.M. Browning and Gustafson Logging, fight to survive  Jay Browning must make tough decisions  smaller outfits find winning strategies.

The gap widens between winners and losers at the halfway point of the season  Stump Branch tests a dangerous logging strategy  the Pihl men play while the bosses are away  a mistake by the Gustafson crew may end a man's career.

The loggers barely survive in a plummeting market  the Gustafson bosses have a close call  an old hook-tender returns to the Browning team, halting Jesse's rise to management  Pihl loses a crucial member of the team.

Some loggers have more reasons to be grateful than do others as Thanksgiving arrives  the Pihl crew loses men to illness  the Gustafson crew's younger members blow off steam  the season's first snowfall bodes a warning for the Stump Branch crew.

The Gustafson crew faces a nearly impossible deadline  half the Pihl crew skips work  Stump Branch mistakes and inexperience put profits and lives at risk  Jay Browning makes a troubling discovery about his next job.
Some crews shut down while others struggle to stay afloat after stormy weather arrives with a vengeance  the stalled housing market hits home for the loggers.
The news of upcoming layoffs worries the men  Gustafson Logging tries to get back on track  Browning races to meet a big deadline  Pihl Logging is under pressure to finish its Pig Farm job.
